summary.zh: 动手前先查需求、变现和留存风险
summary.en: Check demand, monetization and retention risk before building.

description.zh: 动手写代码前做一次简短的风险预演，给出风险结论、最可能失效的假设和最小的验证动作。准备做落地页、MVP、SaaS 产品或重要功能时使用。
description.en: Runs a short pre-mortem before implementation and returns a risk verdict, the assumption most likely to break and the smallest validation step. Use it before building a landing page, MVP, SaaS product or major feature.
